name: Het Israël van Heertje en Bromet
original_name: Het Israël van Heertje en Bromet
overview: Raoul Heertje and Frans Bromet travel to Israel. The country they know well and with which they both feel inextricably linked, partly due to their Jewish background. But also the country that raises questions, irritation, and sometimes anger in them because of the social, political, and religious developments.
